channel.title: Backend Engineering Journal
channel.description: Engineering scalable backends. Exploring distributed systems. Building intelligent infrastructure.

item.title: Harness Engineering: Building Reliable AI Agent Systems
item.description: Why naked LLM loops fail in production, and how to build deterministic execution harnesses with state machines, verification checkpoints, and sandboxed tool execution.

item.title: Python Backend Architecture with FastAPI and Kubernetes
item.description: A production blueprint for deploying high-concurrency FastAPI applications on Kubernetes: graceful shutdowns, worker sizing, asyncpg pools, and zero-downtime rolling updates.

item.title: Building Scalable REST APIs with FastAPI: Async, Pydantic V2, and Zero-Overhead Patterns
item.description: How to avoid event-loop blocking, harness Pydantic V2 speedups, implement clean dependency injection, and handle 15,000+ RPS with clean architectural boundaries.

item.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pooling: Performance and Best Practices
item.description: Why PostgreSQL crashes under 1,000 direct connections, how process-fork overhead degrades CPU cache, and how to configure PgBouncer transaction pooling with Asyncpg.

item.title: Redis Caching Strategies for High-Traffic Applications: Stampede Prevention, Data Structures, and L1/L2 Hierarchies
item.description: Mitigate cache stampedes with probabilistic early expiration, optimize memory usage with packed hashes, and build resilient multi-tier L1/L2 caching systems.

item.title: Designing Event-Driven Microservices with Message Queues: The Outbox Pattern, Deduplication, and Resilient Consumers
item.description: Solve the dual-write problem, guarantee at-least-once message delivery with transactional outbox, and architect strictly idempotent consumers across distributed services.

item.title: Production LLM Inference: Latency, Throughput, and Cost Optimization at Scale
item.description: Dissecting PagedAttention, continuous batching, KV-cache fragmentation, speculative decoding, and the real hardware economics of serving 70B models.

item.title: Building an LLM Evaluation and Benchmarking Toolkit: Metrics, Regression Gates, and Automated Scoring
item.description: Why vibing prompts fails at scale, and how to engineer deterministic evaluation pipelines, LLM-as-a-Judge rubrics, and automated regression test gates in CI/CD.
